title: Deep Learning for Detecting Cyberbullying Across Multiple Social Media Platforms
reasoning: The paper evaluates the detection of cyberbullying, which includes categories such as racism and sexism. It specifically includes a 'racism' category that incorporates slurs and terms related to religious minorities (e.g., Islam, Judaism), and it analyzes religious word clusters in its model's embeddings, thus evaluating how the NLP systems handle religious-based attacks and representation.
